newsitem.title: TAIWAN: GTE in Taiwan mobile phone joint venture.
newsitem.headline: GTE in Taiwan mobile phone joint venture.

text.p: GTE Corp. said Friday it would join a T$6 billion ($222 million) telecommunication venture led by Taiwan's Pacific Electric Wire & Cable Co. Ltd. to do mobile telephone businesses on the island.
GTE did not disclose its stake in the venture, whose investors also include Taiwan's Yageo Corp., Evergreen Marine Corp. and Acer Inc.
Pacific said it would take up 10 percent of the deal, but declined to reveal the stakes of other partners.
GTE would offer technological assistance to Pacific Wire under the agreement, GTE said in a statement.
Mobile telephones is one of several telecom sectors liberalised by Taiwan's parliament in January 1996, opening them up for private and foreign investments.
Before the reforms, telephone, data and other telecom services had been monopolised by the Directorate General of Telecommunications.
GTE's stock was unchanged at $39.125 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
